falsification_tests.title: WSC hash chain continuity
falsification_tests.assumption: WSC tick hashes form an unbroken chain over state diffs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any recomputed tick hash differs from recorded hash or a gap exists.
falsification_tests.strategy: Record ticks, recompute SHA256 over state_diff + prior_hash, verify continuity.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Hash mismatch or chain gap detected.

falsification_tests.title: WSC monotonic tick
falsification_tests.assumption: Tick counter strictly increases without rewind outside replay mode.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Tick decreases or repeats without explicit TRS replay.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run simulation; log ticks; assert strictly increasing sequence.

falsification_tests.title: CEG append-only enforcement
falsification_tests.assumption: CEG events are immutable after insertion.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Event payload mutated post-insert.
falsification_tests.strategy: Insert event, attempt mutation, verify hash mismatch and rejection.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Mutation succeeds or hash does not change.

falsification_tests.title: CEG parent existence
falsification_tests.assumption: All parent_event_ids refer to existing events.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: An event references a missing parent.
falsification_tests.strategy: Generate events with known parents; validate references against index.

falsification_tests.title: CEG ordering determinism
falsification_tests.assumption: Within a tick, event ordering is deterministic across runs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs of the same tick yield different orderings.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay identical tick twice; compare event sequences; assert identical order.

falsification_tests.title: PLS determinism
falsification_tests.assumption: PLS outputs are deterministic for identical CEG inputs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Outputs differ across two runs with same input window.
falsification_tests.strategy: Feed identical CEG window twice; compare PLS outputs byte-for-byte.

falsification_tests.title: PAE frame determinism
falsification_tests.assumption: Given identical inputs, PAE emits identical frames.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Frame hashes differ for identical inputs.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay identical PLS inputs twice; compare pose hashes.

falsification_tests.title: TRS replay accuracy
falsification_tests.assumption: TRS reconstructs state solely from CEG and matches WSC hashes.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Replayed state hash differs from authoritative WSC for same tick.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay CEG to tick N; compare state hash to recorded WSC hash at tick N.

falsification_tests.title: Session handshake completeness
falsification_tests.assumption: Rule hash and version exchange completes before tick 0.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Simulation starts without completed handshake.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate session start; assert handshake_complete flag before first tick.

falsification_tests.title: CEG tiered retention under pruning
falsification_tests.assumption: CRITICAL events survive all pruning cycles.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: CRITICAL event absent after pruning.
falsification_tests.strategy: Insert CRITICAL + AMBIENT events; prune; count CRITICAL events.

falsification_tests.title: CEG hash chain survives pruning
falsification_tests.assumption: Tombstone hashes preserve chain integrity after pruning.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Hash chain verification fails after pruning.
falsification_tests.strategy: Prune AMBIENT events; verify hash chain.

falsification_tests.title: PLS stress fallback announces degradation
falsification_tests.assumption: Under stress, PLS degrades gracefully and announces it.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: PLS silently drops events or crashes under 3x load.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject 3x threshold events; verify degradation_announced flag.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: No degradation announcement or silent event drop.

falsification_tests.title: PAE deterministic fallback
falsification_tests.assumption: Missing inputs produce deterministic fallback pose.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with null inputs produce different poses.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run PAE with null inputs twice; compare output pose hashes.

falsification_tests.title: PAE motion primitive priority ordering
falsification_tests.assumption: Higher-priority primitives always win conflicts.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Lower-priority primitive overrides higher.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject conflicting primitives; verify winner matches priority table.

falsification_tests.title: Network CEG reconciliation
falsification_tests.assumption: Client CEG rolls back on server contradiction.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Client-predicted event persists after server contradiction.
falsification_tests.strategy: Force prediction divergence; verify rollback.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Client-only event persists in authoritative CEG.

falsification_tests.title: Network rule hash identity
falsification_tests.assumption: All peers run identical rule modules.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Peer rule hash differs from server.
falsification_tests.strategy: Hash rule modules per peer; compare against server.

falsification_tests.title: WSC determinism under replay
falsification_tests.assumption: WSC is deterministic: same inputs produce same state.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Replay produces different state hash.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run simulation twice with identical seed+inputs; SHA-256 of final state must match.

falsification_tests.title: No animation types in WSC
falsification_tests.assumption: WSC contains zero animation logic.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Animation type reference found in WSC source.
falsification_tests.strategy: AST scan all files in src/sim/ for animation-related type names.

falsification_tests.title: CEG replay reconstruction fidelity
falsification_tests.assumption: CEG alone reconstructs full simulation timeline.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Reconstructed state diverges from original at any tick.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay from CEG log; diff state sequence against recorded states.

falsification_tests.title: PLS L0 never rendered
falsification_tests.assumption: Layer 0 raw simulation is never directly rendered.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Render pipeline reads directly from L0 state.
falsification_tests.strategy: Trace all render inputs; none may originate from L0 without passing through L1+.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any render input traces to L0.

falsification_tests.title: PAE uses only motion primitives
falsification_tests.assumption: No prebaked event-specific animations exist.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Animation asset named after specific event found.
falsification_tests.strategy: Audit all animation asset names against allowed primitive list: [recoil, collapse, brace, stumble, recoil_absorption].

falsification_tests.title: TRS no hidden state
falsification_tests.assumption: No hidden state advantage exists in any encounter.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: State used in outcome calculation not present in CEG.
falsification_tests.strategy: Enumerate all state reads during outcome calculation; verify each has CEG event source.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any state read lacks CEG source.

falsification_tests.title: FOW is sensor limitation not information suppression
falsification_tests.assumption: Fog of war is sensor limitation inside WSC, not post-query filtering.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: FOW filtering occurs in PLS or rendering layer.
falsification_tests.strategy: Trace FOW data flow; verify filtering occurs in WSC sensor components.

falsification_tests.title: Single causal truth graph
falsification_tests.assumption: All systems derive state exclusively from WSC+CEG.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any non-WSC system writes state not derived from WSC+CEG.
falsification_tests.strategy: Full dependency audit of animation, UI, and replay systems.
